platform.title: Job Platform
platform.description: Platform to scrape. Currently 'naukri' is supported. LinkedIn coming soon.

job_title.title: Job Title / Keyword
job_title.description: Job title or keywords to search for (e.g., 'React Developer', 'Python Engineer', 'Data Scientist')

location.title: Location
location.description: City or region to search in (e.g., 'Pune', 'Bangalore', 'Mumbai', 'India')

experience.title: Experience Level
experience.description: Required experience (e.g., '2 years', '5 years', '8 years'). Leave blank to return all levels.

posted_within.title: Posted Within
posted_within.description: How recently the job was posted

maxResults.title: Maximum Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of jobs to return (1–100 per run)
